R07b.program:
import Bitcoin.Capstone.Block
import Bitcoin.Block.Params
open Bitcoin.Capstone.Block Bitcoin.Block.Params Bitcoin.Serialization

def main : IO UInt32 := do
  let raw := encodeBlock genesisHeader [genesisCoinbaseTx]
  match replayBlock raw { height := 0, prevHash := genesisHeader.hashPrevBlock, utxo := [] } with
  | .error e => IO.println e.reason; return 2
  | .ok report =>
    let value := report.state.utxo.foldl (fun n p => n + p.2.value) (0 : Bitcoin.Data.Amount)
    IO.println s!"genesis_utxo_coins={report.state.utxo.length} genesis_utxo_value={value}"
    return if report.state.utxo.isEmpty then 0 else 1
